gloss: final episode; last installment; final round

definitions.explanation: The concluding episode of a TV drama, anime, manga series, or other serialized work.

definitions.gloss: final round; last inning; last lap
definitions.explanation: The concluding round, inning, or period of a game, competition, or recurring event.

examples.japanese: {最終回|さいしゅうかい}は{来週|らいしゅう}{放送|ほうそう}される。
examples.english: The final episode will air next week.

examples.japanese: あのドラマの{最終回|さいしゅうかい}は{泣|な}けた。
examples.english: The final episode of that drama made me cry.

examples.japanese: {最終回|さいしゅうかい}の{視聴率|しちょうりつ}が{歴代|れきだい}{最高|さいこう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: The final episode recorded the highest viewership ratings in history.

examples.japanese: {最終回|さいしゅうかい}の{攻撃|こうげき}で{逆転|ぎゃくてん}した。
examples.english: They made a comeback in the final inning.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{最終回|さいしゅうかい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: The game has entered the final inning.

examples.japanese: {最終回|さいしゅうかい}のマウンドには{守護神|しゅごしん}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The closer took the mound in the final inning.

notes:
A compound of {最終|さいしゅう} (final) and {回|かい} (episode, round, installment). Most commonly encountered in entertainment contexts (TV, anime, manga) and in baseball.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}スペシャル: final episode special (extended-length finale)
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}を{迎|むか}える: to reach the final episode/round
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}{放送|ほうそう}: final episode broadcast
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}の{結末|けつまつ}: ending of the final episode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最終話|さいしゅうわ}: final episode — uses {話|わ} (story/chapter) instead of {回|かい}; often used for anime and manga
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}: final day of a performance run or sumo tournament — more formal and traditional
- フィナーレ: finale — loanword used for concerts, stage shows, and events
